issues.problem: Card interiors were not mirrored. Only the top bar got direction:rtl; the root div and the Cards are LTR, so title/text bars stay left-aligned and the avatar+label footer sits at the left of every card. AxialStretch cards, which inherit direction:rtl, are correctly right-aligned (avatar at right), so the two comps of the same card are inconsistent and ContactShadowLift cards still read as LTR UI. The report claims the row, top bar and cards were mirrored.
issues.suggestedFix: Add direction:'rtl' to the root div of ContactShadowLift (or to each Card style) so the shared Card fixture lays out RTL exactly like in AxialStretch; then re-render f10/f50/f94 and confirm bars align to the right edge and the avatar is on the right. Update the header comment accordingly.

issues.problem: FaRoot wraps only the title, while direction:rtl is set manually on the root div. Works, but the header comment does not mention that card interiors become RTL through inheritance (which is why the two comps differ). The report's rtlDecisions should record the card-content mirroring decision for both comps.
issues.suggestedFix: Wrap the whole scene in FaRoot and list the card-interior decision in the header comment and report.

issues.problem: Title uses Noto Kufi Arabic 800 for a heavy Impact-like source title. This is acceptable and shaping is correct (کشش محوری, no tracking, no uppercase). The title sits about 18px lower than the original's baseline, which is harmless.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: nudge top by about -10px so the optical center matches the original.

notes: Verified by rendering 15 beat frames with the harness and viewing fa vs orig for both comps. Positives: timing constants, easing, seeds, exports and durations are identical to upstream (diff shows only START_X, target ordering, the transformOrigin flip, the title and the comment changes). AxialStretch mirroring is geometrically correct: cards enter from the left, the first card lands rightmost, the stretch extends toward the leading edge (right) with the trailing-edge origin at 0%, and the landing squash and the dashed slots are consistent (f14, f30, f56, f149 checked). The title shaping is correct, with no letter-spacing, uppercase or fallback font. ContactShadowLift: card order, shadows under their own cards, lift/shadow physics unchanged and the top bar mirrored (logo right, avatar left); the only real defect is the unmirrored card interiors. No leftover Latin/Chinese text, no raster text, no cheating by blur or hiding.
